app.name: WindWatch Console
app.tagline: Hear the wind, hold the line.
common.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy manually.
setup.title: Set up WindWatch Console
setup.intro: Create the single administrator account. This page closes after setup.
login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in to manage your monitors.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: Add your first HTTP or TCP monitor to start collecting status and latency history.
monitor.chooseTypeHint: Choose what you want to monitor.
monitor.httpDescription: Check a URL, expected status code, and an optional keyword.
monitor.tcpDescription: Check whether a TCP port accepts connections.
monitor.dockerDescription: Check that a Docker container is running or healthy.
monitor.pushDescription: Expect periodic heartbeats from a script or device.
monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.name: Name
monitor.keywordHint: Optional, case-sensitive. Up to 1MB of the response body is checked.
monitor.tcpHint: Use this for local ports, database ports, or a local proxy listener.
monitor.optionalChecksHint: Certificate and domain checks only apply to https URLs.
monitor.requireHealthy: Require Docker health status to be healthy
monitor.dockerHint: Uses the Docker endpoint from DOCKER_HOST or the local Unix socket.
monitor.pushHint: After saving, open the detail page to copy the heartbeat URL and token.
monitor.graceHint: 1–300 seconds and less than the heartbeat interval.
monitor.timeoutHint: 1–300 seconds and less than the interval.
monitor.thresholdHint: Consecutive failures or successes, from 1 to 20.
monitor.historyHint: View status and latency by check, hour, and day.
monitor.recentStatusHint: Each bar is one check; spacing follows the monitor interval.
monitor.deleteWarning: Deleting this monitor also deletes its configuration and history. This cannot be undone.
monitor.pushUnavailable: The push token is not available. Recreate this monitor.
proxy.name: Name
proxy.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the current password
proxy.listHint: Monitors can select a proxy in their connection settings.
notification.intro: Manage notification methods; each method selects its own notification language. Delivery history has its own page.
notification.tokenConfigured: A token is configured. Leave blank to keep it.
notification.chatIDsHint: Comma-separated numeric chat IDs or @channel usernames.
notification.secretConfigured: A secret is configured. Leave blank to keep it.
notification.secretHint: Optional. Generate a strong secret and configure the same value on your receiving service. It is not shown again after saving.
notification.webhookHint: Sends a JSON POST. If a secret is set, X-WindWatch-Signature contains sha256=<hex>.
notification.languageHint: Language used for messages sent through this method, independent of the UI language.
events.title: Events
events.emptyBody: Events appear here when a monitor changes state.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.csrf: Your session token is invalid. Refresh the page and try again.
error.invalidCredentials: The username or password is incorrect.
error.invalidRequest: The request could not be processed.
error.passwordShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.
error.passwordLong: Password must be at most 256 characters.
error.usernameShort: Username must be at least 3 characters.
error.usernameLong: Username must be at most 64 characters.
error.usernameTaken: That username is already in use.
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
error.monitorName: Name is required and must be at most 100 characters.
error.interval: Interval must be between 20 and 86400 seconds.
error.timeout: Timeout must be between 1 and 300 seconds and less than the interval.
error.url: Enter a valid http or https URL without embedded credentials.
error.method: Only GET and HEAD are supported.
error.keyword: Keyword must be at most 500 characters; HEAD requests cannot use keywords.
error.host: Host is required and must be at most 255 characters.
error.dockerContainer: Container name or ID is required.
error.certCheck: Certificate checks require an https URL and 1–365 warning days.
error.domainCheck: Domain checks require an https public domain and 1–365 warning days.
error.proxyNotFound: The selected outbound proxy no longer exists.
error.proxyName: Proxy name is required and must be at most 100 characters.
error.proxyType: Proxy type must be http or socks5.
error.proxyAddress: Proxy address must be host:port with a valid port.
error.webhookURL: Webhook URL must be a valid http or https URL.
notice.monitorCreated: Monitor created. Waiting for the first check.
notice.checkStarted: Check requested. Refresh shortly to see the result.
notice.checkRunning: A check is already running for this monitor.
notice.checkPaused: Resume this monitor before running a check.
notify.warnCert:
[CERT] %s
Target: %s
Certificate expires in %d days (%s)
Issuer: %s
notify.warnDomain:
[DOMAIN] %s
Domain: %s
Expires in %d days (%s)
Registrar: %s
Status: %s
notification.remindersHint: Extra notifications after the first alert. 0 disables repeats; intervals are in minutes.
error.reminderCount: Reminder count must be between 0 and 100.
error.reminderInterval: Reminder interval must be between 1 and 525600 minutes.
error.proxyTestFailed: Proxy connectivity test failed. Check the address, type, and credentials.
proxy.testHint: The test connects to example.com:443 through the current form settings without saving.
users.title: Users
users.intro: Create accounts for your team. Viewers can see the dashboard, monitor details, and events but cannot change configuration.
users.createHint: Accounts are created by an administrator. There is no self-registration or email invitation.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
error.lastAdmin: At least one active administrator is required.
error.cannotModifySelf: You cannot disable, delete, or change the role of your own account.
notice.userPasswordReset: Password reset. The user must sign in again.
notice.passwordReset: Password reset. Sign in with the new password.
monitor.pushAdminOnly: Only administrators can view the heartbeat URL and token.
monitor.dailyChartHint: Bars show uptime for each day in the configured timezone; the line shows average latency.
settings.systemIntro: Set the timezone used for display and daily aggregation.
settings.logsIntro: Review the last 100 notification delivery attempts. Records are kept for 365 days.
settings.timezoneSearchHint: Type to filter, for example Asia/Shanghai. Only whole- and half-hour offsets are supported.
settings.publicStatusIntro: Publish a read-only page that does not require a login.
public.monitorsHint: Only monitor names, status, and uptime are shown. Target URLs, configuration, and secrets are never exposed.
public.copyHint: Click the address or the copy button to copy the full link.
error.publicTitle: Page title must be at most 100 characters.
error.publicDescription: Description must be at most 500 characters.
notification.channelsHint: Add as many Telegram bots and webhooks as you need. Each method selects its own language; each monitor chooses which methods receive its alerts.
notification.channelFormHint: Choose how this method sends messages and its notification language. Names must be unique.
notification.channelNameHint: Shown when selecting methods for a monitor.
notification.empty: No notification methods yet. Add one to start receiving alerts.
notification.deleteConfirm: Delete this notification method? Monitors using it will stop sending alerts through it.
error.notificationChannelName: Notification method name is required and must be at most 100 characters.
error.notificationChannelNameTaken: That notification method name is already in use.
error.notificationChannelType: Choose Telegram or webhook as the delivery method.
error.notificationChannelChatIDs: Enter at least one valid Telegram chat ID.
error.notificationChannelToken: A Telegram bot token is required.
error.notificationChannelNotFound: The notification method no longer exists.
error.proxyNameTaken: That proxy name is already in use.
notice.notificationChannelTestFailed: Notification test failed. Check the server log.
proxy.formHint: Proxies are available to HTTP and TCP monitors and to notification methods. Names must be unique.
proxy.deleteConfirm: Delete this proxy? Monitors and notification methods using it will fall back to a direct connection.
users.resetPasswordHint: The user will be signed out everywhere and must sign in with the new password.
monitor.notificationChannelsHint: Untick a method to keep it configured but stop sending this monitor alerts through it.
dashboard.noMatchesHint: Adjust the search or status filter and try again.
events.noMatchesHint: Adjust the search or type filter and try again.
